note: Maneuver and delta-v driven methods: transfer optimization sets the delta-v budget that propulsion sizing meets, while debris avoidance and rendezvous both plan small relative-motion burns.
Constellation design selects orbits reached by transfer optimization and depends on a closed communication link budget for each satellite and inter-satellite link.

Spacecraft bus subsystem design: the space environment drives thermal and radiation design, attitude control points the antenna and manages momentum, and propulsion supports stationkeeping and desaturation.
